eventDetail.scope: With the theme of "AI-Driven Innovation in Engineering Education", EEIT explores how artificial intelligence and emerging technologies are reshaping educational paradigms. The conference will feature keynote speeches, invited talks, paper presentations, and interactive sessions covering curriculum design, intelligent learning systems, modern teaching methodologies, and the integration of AI in educational practices.
